physical_game_crosswalk.source_detail: Dec14 Spokane original detailed report expressly says Gonzaga University defeated Whitman 43-38 last night and names Gonzaga Ray Leonard, high scorer 15; Dec15 AP refers to this win as prior night 43-38. Feb21 Whitman schedule lists Whitman 38, Gonzaga 42, a one-point opposing-record discrepancy; same physical game, not another.

Dec15 original AP detailed next-day Gonzaga Bulldogs vs Whitman win 53-46 last night and Gonzaga halftime 27-26; Feb21 schedule says Whitman 53 Gonzaga 40. Opponent, result, chronology and shared Whitman 53 establish the same second December game despite Gonzaga-score literal conflict.

Jan8 original UP Walla Walla news item explicitly reports Whitman COLLEGE beat Gonzaga UNIVERSITY 54-27 LAST NIGHT (Jan7), names Whitman Mike Reser and Glenn Bullock and Gonzaga Stroyan. Feb21 schedule Whitman 64 Gonzaga 27: opponent, score Gonzaga 27 and chronological place make likely same third game; Whitman 54 vs 64 printed-source conflict; do not make second 27-point Gonzaga game.

Jan10 original AP datelined Walla Walla reports Whitman won over Gonzaga 62-43 SATURDAY NIGHT (Jan8), Gonzaga's third LOSS to Whitman against one Gonzaga victory. Feb21 Whitman season summary agrees 62-43; this fixes fourth result's exact date and corroborates all-four shared physical game count.
